answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Reaching the timber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Work waits on the summit until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the canyon of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
